reference_policy: Every identity uses only assets/v18/monster-motion-<id>.png as appearance reference. No borrowed species.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high resolution production 2D side-view game character action sprite sheet, transparent background. Output large 4:3 landscape image, ideally2048×1536 pixels, arranged EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of equal square cells, twelve poses total. Full body in every cell, all same physical character scale, viewed from left side facing RIGHT, generous transparent gutters, no cropping. Reference image is the exact monster identity to preserve; generate only that identity, same color palette and anatomical parts. Crisp finely painted dark outlined fantasy game art at native full cell resolution; no pixel art, no blur, no upscaled lowresolution appearance. Top row: attack windup1, active attack2poses, recovery1. Middle row: four distinct subtle hurt/flinch poses. Bottom row: two ready/windup poses, two braking poses, final pose returns to neutral. Same ground-foot contact line within every cell, no shadows, no ground scenery, no detached particles or weapon VFX, no text/numbers/grid. Do not dissolve, explode or change species. Do not enlarge or shrink whole body between frames; animate limbs and pose only. The exact dark slate blue moss-armored beetle in the reference: dome of overlapping curved chitin shell plates with patches of green moss, little mushroom and twig growth on shell, black face with amber orange eye, two dark antennae ending in amber droplets, six sturdy pointed claw legs. Keep its low wide silhouette, no horn. Attack: raise a foreclaw then execute a short forward pincer/claw slash in two poses, recover to all legs grounded. Hurt: four distinct small recoil/flinch poses, antennae swept back and legs brace, intact body. Prepare: two crouched ready postures; Brake: front legs spread to stop then neutral standing posture matching reference.

layout_repairs.prompt: Precise image edit: keep the exact same monster identity, illustration style, all twelve animation poses, palette, row order and 4 columns × 3 rows layout of this transparent sprite sheet. Fix ONLY sprite spacing and clipping: make each complete character drawing uniformly30% smaller inside its own grid cell and center it so that EVERY antenna tip, claw, horn, wing and limb has a generous completely TRANSPARENT margin at least40px on all four sides. In all 12 cells keep the same uniform physical body scale. Nothing may overlap or touch neighboring cell drawings. Do not crop or cut any limb or antenna. Preserve crisp high resolution painted detail; draw the same monsters freshly if needed. Canvas large 4:3 landscape, ideally2048×1536pixels, no background, no text, no numbers, no frames/gridlines. Final pose bottom right is neutral standing. Exact same 12pose actions, just well separated production sprites.
